rules.text: Decision traversal starts at the requested workspace scope and follows parent links toward the root. Parent links are read-only during decide.
Any explicit deny for the subject at the requested scope or any ancestor wins over every allow in that chain.
If the chain contains no explicit deny, an allow at the requested scope or any ancestor permits access. The closest allow to the requested scope supplies exact reason allow:<scope>.
A disabled subject is denied before rule traversal, even when allow rules exist. enable restores normal evaluation.
If no deny and no allow is found in the chain, decide returns DENY with exact reason default-deny.
Trace is append-only and copied on read. Configuration mutations emit parent/allow/deny/disable/enable; each decide emits exactly permit or reject after resolution.

callableSurface.ownership: The workspace permission owns parent links, subject-scope rules, disabled state and trace. Callers supply immutable subject/scope strings.

transitions: parent/rule mutation changes future evaluation only
decision does not mutate rules or parent links

eventOrdering: configuration events are emitted after their mutation
disabled/suspended rejection is resolved before parent traversal
deny precedence is resolved before allow result
permit/reject is the final event for one decision
abortErrorPrecedence: There is no abort/error surface. disabled has first decision precedence, then explicit deny anywhere in the chain, then closest allow, then default deny.

identityMutation.inputs: subject and scope strings are read only
identityMutation.rules: decide/check never mutates parent links or rules
identityMutation.trace: trace returns a new array with new event objects
